title: email sent from another device using gmail not showing up in thunderbird gmail folders
creator: danbecker75
content: i sometimes send email using gmail app on mobile devices. the gmail web application shows those sent messages with the gmail sent label. Those messages dont sync up in thunderbird on my windows pc, under the gmail smtp account using the same user name. email sent from thunderbird does show up in the gmail sent folder. How to get sent email synced up between devices?
